transcript: Speaker A: So, how's life going for you? Speaker B: Uh, going on... life... good. Speaker A: Yeh kya bol raha hai? Tinder pe toh badi tez tez reply de rahe the English mein. Hawa nikal gayi tumhari? Tum toh fraud nikle. [What are you saying? You replied so fast in English on Tinder. Lost your confidence? You are a fraud.] Speaker B: Dhoka? Sorry. [Deceived? Sorry.] Speaker A: Kyun? Darr gaye na? English bolna koi badi baat nahi hai. Mobile nikalo aur English Seekho app download karo. [Why? Scared? Speaking English is no big deal. Get your phone and download English Seekho.] Speaker B: English Seekho app? Yeh kya hai? [English Seekho app? What is that?] Speaker A: English Seekho app spoken English ka best app hai. Jahan basic se advanced level tak farratedar English bolna step-by-step sikhaya jata hai. Iska AI coach one-on-one practice karwata hai bina mazak udaye aur galtiyan correct karta hai. [English Seekho is the best spoken English app. It teaches fluent English step-by-step from basic to advanced. Its AI coach offers one-on-one practice without judgment and corrects mistakes.] Speaker B: Oh wow! Main abhi download karta hoon. [Oh wow! I will download it now.] Speaker C: Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [Click the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho, INSTALL NOW, [Disclaimer text about educational purposes and results varying]
summary: A woman teases her date for his poor spoken English compared to his fluent texts on Tinder. She recommends the English Seekho app, highlighting its step-by-step lessons and supportive AI coach. The ad concludes with a call to action to install the app.
